content: Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.1 testing: override SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI to 'sqlite:///:memory:' in app config before test_client. Use 'with app.app_context(): db.create_all()' in fixture setup and 'db.drop_all()' in teardown. Each test gets fresh in-memory schema. SQLite in-memory uses StaticPool and check_same_thread=False automatically. Seed data via db.session.add() calls inside app_context.
